title: mentha pulegium var. tomentella
intro: Mentha pulegium var. tomentella, commonly known as woolly pennyroyal, is a variety of the pennyroyal plant, a member of the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, relieve stress and anxiety, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Mentha pulegium var. tomentella include its antiseptic, anti-spasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, menthol, and pulegone, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
